With no genuine pace pressure and Seeyouinmydreams' class edge evident in his 121 OR, this race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can stay close to the pace.

This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical pace, as the single leader creates a perfect target for horses that can track the pace without getting too far back in a slowly-run affair.

scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the last hurdle with little separation in the field, favouring horses with natural speed rather than stamina. Those with the quickest turn of foot over the final 2-3 furlongs hold the edge.

races.paceDynamic: William Of York will lead from the start with no other confirmed front runners to pressure him early. The numerous prominent runners including Wee Alki, Stylish Recruit, It's Maisy, and Dillarchie will settle just behind, creating a solid but not frantic gallop. The substantial hold-up contingent featuring Divilabother, East Eagle, and Belladinotte will be relying on William Of York maintaining a steady tempo to the second-last hurdle. This shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the lone leader and kick clear before the hold-up horses can mount their challenge.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If William Of York sets a steady tempo without burning out the field
scenarios.body: The prominent pack will be perfectly positioned to strike turning for home while the hold-up horses have too much ground to make up. Horses like It's Maisy, Dillarchie, and Stylish Recruit can use their tactical speed to win the race in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian and William Of York compounds over the final fences
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the last hurdle where staying power matters less than a turn of foot. East Eagle or Belladinotte could emerge from the pack with perfectly timed runs to catch the prominent horses napping.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: William Leads Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If William Of York gets an easy lead and the field allows him too much rope
scenarios.body: The leader will have enough left in the tank to repel all challengers, especially if the prominent runners mark each other rather than going after the leader. His recent poor form makes this unlikely but the tactical setup could suit.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Scramble Finish
scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners go too early and come back to the field
scenarios.body: The race becomes a war of attrition where the horse with the most stamina rather than tactical positioning prevails. This chaotic scenario could throw up an outsider from any part of the field.

watchPoints.text: William Of York could get an uncontested lead if the prominent runners are too patient early
It's Maisy and Dillarchie both in hot form and ideally positioned to strike from prominent positions
East Eagle's recent win form makes him the primary hold-up danger if the pace becomes pedestrian
Multiple 3lb and 5lb claimers could cause interference in a competitive handicap finish
Dusky Days returning from 252 days off represents either a fitness concern or a well-handicapped angle
